slot.brief: Given two groups with known means and variances, find the combined mean and combined variance using pooled formulas.

stem: Two sections contribute data to a pooled set. Their sizes, means and variances are $(20,12,3)$ and $(40,15,9)$, respectively. The pooled mean and standard deviation are

verdicts.working: Pooled mean = (20×12 + 40×15)/60 = 14. Pooled variance = [20(3 + (12−14)²) + 40(9 + (15−14)²)]/60 = 9, so the standard deviation is 3.
